column1: This file was created using the 202609 Bloomberg database. It contains
value- and equal-weighted returns for the intersections of 2 ME portfolios
and 4 BE/ME portfolios and 4 OP portfolios in Developed.
The portfolios are constructed at the end of June.
The annual returns are from January to December.
